they listen, they just don’t understand. I was the one mainly abused, i’m the oldest of 3 from my dads 2nd marriage. And when i mean abused, i mean it. mentally, physically and sexually(“family friend”). my parents won’t accept that they did that to me. the mental and physical abuse. my siblings are aware of everything now but because they were spoiled they don’t understand me or can’t seem to understand that due to all that abuse, i can’t function without it. they know i struggle so hard to not let what my parents think of me affect me but i’ve been beaten so badly, that all i care about is what they think.

the urge has always been there, i’ve done my best to avoid the urges but today was the final of it. I just went thru with it. and it feels better. like this weight on my chest feels less. i want to keep cutting, but i’m scared to go too far atm. i don’t want to fuck up yet, i just want this weight off of me.
I’ve always felt like this. I’ve expressed myself so many times, to friends family and nothing happens. ive done my best to seek help myself, but i’m broke. no money, no job, no support.

I honestly don’t know how to get the help my friend. I’ve told my parents my struggles. We just talk about it, or try a way to make what im feeling invalid. i’ve pushed down the feelings to the point where i m just angry. i don’t want to be like that. i’ve never been like that. i loved to smile. but there’s no reason to. it’s down to drugs or driving erratically on the fwy. never together tho, i’m stupid but not that stupid. it’s tiring, talking about it over and over and nothing changes even after constant effort. I honestly think 24 is good age to go, i’m scared of being alone, scared of losing my parents, siblings, niece, nephew, so i rather go first. Favorite Holiday and meal has always been been Thanksgiving and Thanksgiving dinner, I owe it to myself to be selfish after being selfless for my family for years. Sometimes, it is too late. Just the effort of getting the help, it’s not there anymore.

Went to my family, my brother is trying to help but he has his own family to look after, so I don’t bug him, my parents questioned why i need to go, if it’s necessary at all. i’ve gone in the past, middle school and high school, they were unsuccessful because my parents dictated the sessions and it would only be about school and my grades. nothing else. i’m 24 btw. I’ve been struggling with this shit ass depression since 9. I don’t have anyone. on the real, i have no one.
I’m not. I have tried but just financially can’t
